Anya F.: Quick heads-up — we plan to start a metering policy A/B cohort tomorrow morning. Cohort A = current per-token model, Cohort B = new per-1000-token buckets. Need billing ops + legal sign-off and a sample invoice. CC @Simon L.
Simon L.: Ack. Can you drop the cohort definitions and the sheet link?
Anya F.: Sheet: https://redwood-internal/sheets/metering-rollout (view-only). Cohorts: A: unchanged pricing; B: bucketed SKUs (1000-token blocks). Users assigned by random hash.
Maria P.: Quick Q — what's the expected revenue delta from B? rough % is fine.
Kevin R.: Back-of-envelope +1.8% net MRR if usage distribution holds (more rounding benefits). Will verify with the usage sample.
BillingBot: Invoice preview generated for cohort B: https://redwood-internal/preview/preview-cohortB-1786 (expires in 24h).
Liam (Eng): Rollout window scheduled 02:00-04:00 UTC. Feature flag: `metering.metering_v2` will gate cohorts. Example flag payload: ```json
{"flag":"metering.metering_v2","variants":["A","B"],"seed":12345}```
Simon L.: Do we need any grandfathering rules for enterprise contracts? I can imagine a few named accounts that shouldn't change.
Anya F.: Enterprise tiers are excluded by default via the billing whitelist. We'll do a manual add for the 5 large customers flagged in the sheet column `enterprise_exempt`.
Kevin R.: I'll produce proforma PDFs for the top-5 accounts and an itemized CSV for finance reconciliation by EOD.
Maria P.: Also adding a short note on the billing page: "Metering bucket updates won't affect committed reserved plans" — please review wording.
Anya F.: Copy — Kevin, once you have the proformas, ping legal for billing language check. Simon, can you confirm the analytics event names we should use to track cohort conversion?
Simon L.: Using `billing_migration_cohort` with property `cohort: A|B`, and `billing_preview_click`. I'll add to analytics doc.
Kevin R.: Proformas: queued. Will attach to this thread when ready.
Anya F.: Thanks everyone. If we see any invoice parsing errors after the preview step, tag @BillingBot troubleshoot. :thumbsup:
